title: Openness of the bounded finite free residue locus
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $d,i,r\in\mathbb N$, and $P$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-derived-category] with zero terms in degrees below $0$ and above $d$. Suppose each term is isomorphic to $\mathcal O_Y^{s_n}$ for a finite integer $s_n$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. For $y\in Y$ let $P_y$ be termwise pullback along $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)\to Y$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. The set of $y$ for which $H^q(P_y)=0$ for every $q\in\mathbb N$ other than $i$ and $H^i(P_y)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] is open in $Y$.

proof.text: Choose bases for the finite free terms. For every field-valued point, apply rank-nullity to the outgoing map and to the quotient of its kernel by the incoming image: β(q)+ρ(q)+ρ(q-1)=s_q. This is exactly the existing proved declaration finrank_homology_pullback_add_rank_add_rank. Over a field, the proved finite_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj_homology_pullback gives finite dimensionality, and the two proved field-spectrum criteria identify zero/rank-r homology with dimensions zero/r.

A matrix has rank at least a if and only if some a-by-a minor has nonzero determinant. Choose a maximal nonzero minor at the point. Its basic open gives an open neighbourhood on which this rank cannot decrease; for rank zero its determinant is 1. This is exists_residue_rank_le, proved in this delivery from the existing le_rank_map_appTop_iff. The same rank-nullity formula for the two adjacent matrices gives the existing proved upper-semicontinuity bound exists_finrank_homology_pullback_le.

At y in the locus, intersect the upper-semicontinuity neighbourhoods for q=0,...,d and the four lower-rank neighbourhoods for differential degrees i-2,...,i+1. The first set of conditions makes all homology off i vanish. Apply the rank-nullity identities in degrees i-1 and i+1: the old β is zero, all four ranks can only increase, and the sum is bounded by the same term rank; thus all four ranks stay fixed. The identity in degree i then gives β(i)=r. Degrees outside [0,d] vanish by support, including the negative degree i-1 when i=0. The intersection is the desired open neighbourhood. The code proves each arithmetic equality by omega; finite intersections and the pointwise neighbourhood criterion finish openness.

from.place: Proof steps 1--3: the residue cohomology condition defines an open locus.

lean.statement:
theorem isOpen_finiteFree_residue_locus
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (i r : ℕ) :
    IsOpen {y : Y | ((∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero
          ((((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecResidueField y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
            P).homology q)) ∧
        ((((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecResidueField y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
          P).homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r)}
